skills.name: Fist of Conviction
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gepard's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Daunting Smite
skills.desc:
Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gepard's ATK to one designated enemy, with a #2[i]% base chance to Freeze the enemy for #3[i] turn(s).
While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice Additional DMG equal to #4[i]% of Gepard's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

skills.name: Enduring Bulwark
skills.desc: Applies a Shield to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gepard's DEF plus #3[i] for #2[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Unyielding Will
skills.desc: When struck with a killing blow, instead of becoming knocked down, Gepard's HP immediately restores to #1[i]% of his Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

skills.name: Comradery
skills.desc: After Gepard uses his Technique, when the next battle begins, a Shield will be applied to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gepard's DEF plus #3[i] for #2[i] turn(s).

passives.name: Integrity
passives.desc: Gepard has a higher chance to be attacked by enemies.

passives.name: Commander
passives.desc: When "Unyielding Will" is triggered, Gepard's Energy will be restored to 100%.

passives.name: Grit
passives.desc: Gepard's ATK increases by 35% of his current DEF. This effect will refresh at the start of each turn.
